name: Creamy Chicken Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in a large pot of salted water according to the package instructions. Save one glass of pasta water, then drain.
Cut the chicken into small cubes and season with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Heat the oil in a pan and cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until golden. Set aside on a plate.
In the same pan, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic for 3 minutes.
Pour in the cream and add the Parmesan. Let the sauce thicken for 3 minutes over low heat.
Return the chicken to the pan and add the pasta. Mix everything together, adding a little pasta water if the sauce is too thick. Serve hot.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Finely chop the onion, garlic, and carrot (or grate the carrot).
Heat the oil in a large pan and sauté the onion, garlic, and carrot for 5 minutes.
Add the ground beef and cook for 8 minutes, breaking it apart with a wooden spoon.
Add the tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Simmer over low heat for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in salted water, drain, and serve with the sauce.

name: Chocolate Lava Cake
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C and grease 6 ramekins (or one baking dish).
Melt the chocolate and butter, cut into pieces, using a double boiler or microwave, stirring occasionally.
In a mixing bowl, whisk the eggs and sugar until the mixture becomes pale and fluffy.
Pour in the melted chocolate, then add the flour and mix well.
Divide the batter evenly among the ramekins.
Bake for 12 minutes for a molten center (20 minutes if using one large baking dish). Serve warm.

name: Soft and Fluffy Yogurt Cake
ingredients: 1 pot of plain yogurt (use the pot as a measuring cup)
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C and grease a loaf cake pan.
Pour the yogurt into a mixing bowl, then add the sugar, vanilla sugar, and eggs. Mix well.
Add the oil and lemon zest.
Sift in the flour and baking powder, then mix until you obtain a smooth batter.
Pour the batter into the cake pan.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes. The cake is ready when a knife inserted into the center comes out clean. Let it cool before removing it from the pan.

name: Orange and Mango Juice
steps: Squeeze the oranges to extract their juice.
Peel the mango and cut the flesh into pieces.
Blend the mango with the orange juice (and honey if desired) until smooth.
Serve chilled with ice cubes.

name: French Potato Gratin (Gratin Dauphinois)
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Rub a baking dish with a garlic clove, then butter the dish.
Peel the potatoes and cut them into thin slices. Do not wash them, so they retain their starch.
Mix the cream, milk, minced garlic, salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Arrange the potato slices in layers in the baking dish and pour the cream mixture over them.
Sprinkle with grated Gruyère cheese if desired.
Bake for 1 hour, until the top is golden brown. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

name: Homemade Burger
steps: Divide the ground beef into 4 portions and shape them into patties slightly wider than the buns. Season with salt and pepper.
Slice the onion, cut the tomato into rounds, and wash the lettuce.
Cook the patties in a hot pan for 3 to 4 minutes on each side. Place a slice of cheddar on each patty at the end of cooking.
Lightly toast the burger buns after cutting them in half.
Spread the sauces on the buns, then layer the lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, and beef patty.
Close the burgers and serve immediately, with fries if desired.

name: Homemade Pizza
steps: Mix the yeast, sugar, and lukewarm water. Let it rest for 10 minutes until the mixture becomes foamy.
In a mixing bowl, combine the flour and salt, then add the yeast mixture and oil.
Knead for 10 minutes until you obtain a soft dough. Cover and let it rise for 1 hour in a warm place.
Preheat the oven to 240°C. Roll out the dough onto a baking tray.
Spread the tomato sauce over the dough, add the mozzarella, your chosen toppings, and oregano.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the crust is golden and the cheese has melted.

name: Chicken Shawarma
ingredients: Lettuce, tomatoes, red onion, and pickles
Sauce: 4 tablespoons yogurt, 1 garlic clove, and a squeeze of lemon juice
steps: Cut the chicken into thin strips.
Mix the yogurt, oil, crushed garlic, lemon juice, and all the spices. Add the chicken and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Prepare the sauce by mixing the yogurt, crushed garlic, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Cook the chicken in a hot pan for 8 to 10 minutes, until golden brown and fully cooked.
Warm the pita breads and fill them with lettuce, tomatoes, onion, and pickles.
Add the chicken, drizzle with the sauce, roll tightly, and serve.

name: Vegetable Soup
steps: Peel and cut all the vegetables into pieces.
Heat the oil in a large pot and sauté the onion and leeks for 5 minutes.
Add the remaining vegetables, water, and stock cube.
Bring to a boil, then cook over medium heat for 25 minutes.
Blend until smooth. Adjust the seasoning and serve hot.

name: Beef and Carrot Stew
ingredients: 1 sprig of thyme and 1 bay leaf
steps: Cut the beef into large cubes. Peel and cut the vegetables into pieces.
Heat the oil in a large pot and brown the beef on all sides. Set aside.
Sauté the onions and garlic for 3 minutes, then return the beef to the pot. Sprinkle with flour and mix.
Add the tomato paste, stock, thyme, bay leaf, salt, and pepper.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes, then continue cooking for 40 minutes. The meat should be tender.

name: Thieboudienne (Senegalese Fish and Rice)
ingredients: 1 kg fish (white grouper, sea bream, or grouper), cut into pieces
2 carrots, 1 eggplant, 1/4 cabbage, 1 turnip, 1 sweet potato
3 tablespoons tomato paste and 2 fresh tomatoes
Stuffing (rof): 1 bunch of parsley, 3 garlic cloves, 1 small onion, salt, and pepper
steps: Prepare the stuffing by finely chopping the parsley, garlic, onion, salt, and pepper together. Make cuts in the fish and fill them with this mixture.
Heat the oil in a large pot and fry the fish for 10 minutes until golden. Set aside.
In the same oil, sauté the sliced onion, then add the tomato paste and fresh tomatoes. Cook for 10 minutes.
Pour in 2 liters of water, add the stock cube and chili pepper, then bring to a boil.
Add the vegetables and cook for 25 minutes. Remove them when tender, then return the fish to the sauce for 10 minutes before removing it again.
Wash the rice, add it to the remaining sauce (approximately 1 liter), and cook covered over low heat for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve the rice on a large platter and arrange the fish and vegetables on top.

name: Chicken Yassa
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, cut into pieces (or 1 kg chicken thighs)
1 chili pepper (optional) and a few olives
steps: Thinly slice the onions. Mix them with the lemon juice, mustard, crushed garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken to the marinade and let it rest for at least 2 hours (ideally overnight) in the refrigerator.
Remove the chicken from the marinade (keep the onions) and grill it in the oven or in a pan until golden brown.
Heat the oil in a large pot, add the marinated onions, and cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the chicken, bay leaf, crumbled stock cube, one glass of water, and chili pepper. Simmer over low heat for 30 minutes.
Add the olives at the end of cooking and serve with white rice.

name: Mafe (Senegalese Peanut Sauce Stew)
ingredients: 800 g meat (beef or chicken), cut into pieces
200 g natural peanut paste (unsweetened peanut butter)
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and brown the meat with the sliced onions.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes.
Dilute the peanut paste in a little warm water, then pour it into the pot with the remaining water, salt, pepper, and chili pepper.
Simmer over low heat for 40 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent the sauce from sticking.
Add the vegetables cut into large pieces and continue cooking for 30 minutes, until the sauce thickens and the oil rises to the surface.
Serve hot with white rice.

name: Thiakry (Millet Couscous Dessert)
steps: Lightly moisten the millet couscous and steam it for 20 minutes.
Mix the hot couscous with the butter, then let it cool completely, separating the grains with a fork.
In a mixing bowl, combine the yogurt, condensed milk, vanilla sugar, nutmeg, and raisins.
Add the cooled couscous to the cream mixture and gently stir.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. Serve well chilled.

name: Bissap (Hibiscus Juice)
steps: Rinse the hibiscus flowers with cold water.
Bring the water to a boil, add the flowers, and boil for 10 minutes.
Turn off the heat, add the mint, and let it steep for 2 hours.
Strain the liquid, add the sugar and vanilla sugar, then stir until dissolved.
Refrigerate and serve well chilled with ice cubes.
